candidates.title: DASC: Decay-Aware State Compression for Hybrid Linear-Attention Serving
candidates.reason: KDA/GDNのretention horizonを利用してpersistent recurrent-state checkpointをragged圧縮しTP rank間もbalance。2.63倍圧縮でmean TTFT 42.6%削減、input throughput 68.4%向上。

candidates.title: CateKV: On Sequential Consistency for Long-Context LLM Inference Acceleration
candidates.reason: attention headのsequential consistencyに応じcritical tokenのみ保持するhybrid KV cache。memory最大2.72倍削減、single decode 2.18倍、batch throughput 3.96倍。

candidates.title: A Probabilistic Interpretation of KV Cache Eviction
candidates.reason: KV evictionを確率的expectation estimationとして形式化し、decode-time correctionを導入。既存heuristicをbiased estimatorとして統一的に解釈し同一compression budgetでtask robustnessを改善。

candidates.title: Beyond Sparse Weights: When Is Attention Compressible?
candidates.reason: attention mapの見かけのsparsityではなくmass/value/future query/taskからKV compressibilityを整理し、tail-summary slotを持つCertKVを提案。packed Llama prototypeで10倍cache budget。

candidates.title: Learning how to Forget: Fine-tuning for Long-Context Sparse Attention
candidates.reason: 任意KV cache policyへmodelをco-adaptさせるfine-tuningとH2O専用SDPA kernelを含むopen-source KeysAndValuesを提示。長文脈sparse attentionの品質・実装両面に直接関連。
